title: Mutendi Akavanzika
intro: Mudzimba dzesimba dzakapfuma, umo kusatenda neudzvinyiriri zvaitonga, inzwi rechokwadi rakataura richibva panzvimbo isingatarisirwi. Munhu uyu akaedza simba rekudzivirira nhume, achiisa kuchengetedzwa kwavo panjodzi kuti vazivise chokwadi.
clues: Ndaigara munyika ine hutsinye hukuru, ndichishandira mutongi aizviti ndiMwari.
Ndakavanza zvandaitenda zvechokwadi kwemakore akawanda, ndichitya migumisiro yekuzviisa pachena.
Pakauya mutumwa nezviratidzo zvakajeka, ndakatenda, asi vanhu vangu vakamumukira.
Ndakamira pamberi pemudzvinyiriri nedare rake, ndichipikisa kuti havafaniri kuuraya nhume isina mhosva.
Ndakavanyevera nezvekurangwa kwemarudzi ekare akaramba chokwadi, sevanhu vaNoa na'Ad.
Allah vakandiponesa kubva muzvirongwa zvavo zvakaipa, uye ndakaona kuparadzwa kwehurumende inodzvinyirira.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
